pairs: Let the house of Aaron now say:
Let those who fear the Lord now say:
In my tribulation, I called upon the Lord.
et exaudivit me in latitudine Dominus.
And the Lord heeded me with generosity.
non timebo quid faciat mihi homo.
I will not fear what man can do to me.
And I will look down upon my enemies.
It is good to trust in the Lord,
rather than to trust in man.
It is good to hope in the Lord,
rather than to hope in leaders.
All the nations have surrounded me.
And, in the name of the Lord,
I have been avenged over them.
Surrounding me, they closed in on me. And,
in the name of the Lord,
I have been avenged over them.
They surrounded me like a swarm,
et exarserunt sicut ignis in spinis:
and they burned like fire among the thorns. And,
in the name of the Lord,
I have been avenged over them.
I was overturned so as to fall.
But the Lord took me up.
Fortitudo mea et laus mea Dominus,
The Lord is my strength and my praise.
et factus est mihi in salutem.
And he has become my salvation.
Vox exsultationis et salutis in tabernaculis justorum.
A voice of exultation and salvation is in the tabernacles of the just.
The right hand of the Lord has wrought virtue.
The right hand of the Lord has exalted me.
The right hand of the Lord has wrought virtue.
And I will declare the works of the Lord.
When chastising, the Lord chastised me.
But he has not delivered me over to death.
Open the gates of justice to me.
I will enter them, and I will confess to the Lord.
This is the gate of the Lord.
The just will enter by it.
I will confess to you because you have heard me.
et factus es mihi in salutem.
And you have become my salvation.
The stone which the builders have rejected,
hic factus est in caput anguli.
this has become the head of the corner.
By the Lord has this been done,
et est mirabile in oculis nostris.
and it is a wonder before our eyes.
Hæc est dies quam fecit Dominus;
This is the day that the Lord has made.
Benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini:
Blessed is he who arrives in the name of the Lord.
We have blessed you from the house of the Lord.
Establish a solemn day amid a dense crowd,
even to the horn of the altar.
Deus meus es tu, et confitebor tibi;
You are my God, and I will confess to you.
Deus meus es tu, et exaltabo te.
You are my God, and I will exalt you.
I will confess to you, for you have heeded me.
et factus es mihi in salutem.
And you have become my salvation.
